newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cenbank tells bank to pay depositors.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cenbank tells bank to pay depositors.

text.p: Argentina's Central Bank said Friday it authorized Banco Union Comercial e Industrial (BUCI) to begin paying off its depositors as of next week, using funds from the bank deposit insurance scheme.
Banco BUCI was taken over by the Central Bank in August 1996, when it had deposits of 339.9 million pesos.
Of 65,000 savers to be paid up to 1,000 pesos each, some 38,000 will receive all their money back.
The Central Bank added that it hoped soon to able to sell Banco BUCI, which would mean that no funds would be needed from the bank deposit insurance scheme.
The bank deposit insurance scheme is funded by banks and was set up after the 1995 banking crisis.
